arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ

translations.en.pickthall: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
translations.en.yusufali: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),

translations.en.pickthall: Until ye come to the graves.
translations.id.indonesian: sampai kamu masuk ke dalam kubur.

translations.en.sahih: No! You are going to know.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
translations.en.yusufali: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).
translations.id.indonesian: Janganlah begitu, kelak kamu akan mengetahui (akibat perbuatanmu itu),

translations.en.sahih: Then no! You are going to know.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
translations.id.indonesian: dan janganlah begitu, kelak kamu akan mengetahui.

translations.en.sahih: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)
translations.id.indonesian: Janganlah begitu, jika kamu mengetahui dengan pengetahuan yang yakin,

translations.en.sahih: You will surely see the Hellfire.
translations.id.indonesian: niscaya kamu benar-benar akan melihat neraka Jahiim,

translations.en.sahih: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
translations.en.pickthall: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
translations.en.yusufali: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar akan melihatnya dengan 'ainul yaqin.

translations.en.sahih: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
translations.en.pickthall: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
translations.en.yusufali: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian kamu pasti akan ditanyai pada hari itu tentang kenikmatan (yang kamu megah-megahkan di dunia itu).
